# `prefer-log-over-print`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: style · Profile: idiomatic · Default: off · Fixes: quick fix · Options: none

Reports `std.debug.print` outside test blocks and executable entrypoint files.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

Debug printing is unconditional stderr output; `std.log` lets an embedding
application select levels, scopes, and destinations.

## When it fires

Tests and files defining `main` or `build` may intentionally write command
output. A per-site action changes other calls to `std.log.debug`, but is not
fix-all because the correct log level requires judgment.

<!-- rule-docs:footer (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
## Example

```zig
const std = @import("std");

pub fn report(count: usize) void {
    std.debug.print("count: {d}\n", .{count});
}
```
